about.title: I AM AVAILABLE FOR FULL STACK DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS
about.description: Results-driven Full Stack Developer based in Brussels, Belgium. I specialize in Java (Spring Boot), Python (FastAPI, Django), and modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js). Experienced in Agile methodologies, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and CI/CD pipelines. Also an International Kickboxing Champion with 25 professional fights.

details.title: Spring Boot & Angular Web Application
details.description:
Built a comprehensive web application using Spring Boot for the backend and Angular for the frontend. Developed RESTful APIs, integrated JWT Authentication, and applied TDD to ensure high-quality solutions.

Collaborated at Pretty Code as a Junior Full Stack Java Developer, integrating key features for user management, security, and data validation.

details.title: FastAPI Project — Users, Companies & Planning
details.description:
Developed a FastAPI backend for managing users, companies, and planning activities with JWT authentication. Includes automated testing with PyTest and is deployed using Docker.

Clean architecture with modular routers and dependency injection patterns.

details.title: Boxer App — Boxer Profile Management
details.description:
Created a Node.js backend and Vue.js frontend for managing boxer profiles with full CRUD operations. Features include profile creation, update, deletion, and listing with a clean responsive UI.

Backend: Node.js + Express.js + MySQL. Frontend: Vue.js.

details.title: MesProduits — Product Management App
details.description:
Developed an Angular project for managing product details with complete CRUD operations. Clean component-based architecture with reactive forms and Angular routing.

Focus on Angular best practices and reusable component design.

details.title: Freelance — Backend Services & CI/CD
details.description:
Developed backend services using Python (FastAPI, Django) and Java (Spring Boot) for various freelance clients. Implemented automated testing with PyTest, JUnit, and Playwright.

Deployed applications in Docker/Linux environments with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows.

details.title: Full Stack — Frontend & Database Integration
details.description:
Supported frontend integration with React, Angular, and Vue.js for full-stack delivery across multiple projects. Managed data with PostgreSQL and MySQL, ensuring performance and reliability.

Collaborated on code reviews and maintained clean, maintainable codebases using Git.
